subject: MAP & dataset onramp: cadence for Mercury Analytics pilot
messages:
From: Sara Park <sara.park@mercury-analytics.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot MAP & dataset exchange — initial ask

Hi Olga / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency and cost controls. We'd like to move forward with a small pilot to validate Redwood's quality on our retail summarization evaluation.

High-level ask: exchange a small prompt pack + ~5k labeled test cases so we can run head-to-head evaluations and sanity-check quality regression after quantization. We understand Redwood's usual usage constraints; below are the things we care about most:
- Timeboxed access (30 days) and ephemeral deletion after acceptance
- Narrow scope: only for model quality validation (no external redistribution)
- Auditability: access logs / who pulled data during the pilot

Can you share a MAP draft (timelines, acceptance gates, legal points) and the mechanism for delivering the prompt pack and testcases? We'll have Legal and Data Privacy on standby — I can loop them once we have a proposed timeline.

Target runway: start ingestion week of Nov 16, acceptance gate by Dec 7. Let us know feasibility and any blockers.

Thanks,
Sara Park
Product Partnerships — Mercury Analytics
[attachment: Mercury_Data_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Park <sara.park@mercury-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP & dataset exchange — initial ask

Sara — really glad to hear the demo resonated.

I've attached a lean MAP for the pilot that mirrors what we've done for similar validation projects. Quick summary of our proposed flows (see Redwood_MAP_proposal_v1.pdf attached):
- Onramp window: Nov 16–20 (secure S3 staging + short-lived credentials)
- Evaluation window: Nov 23–Dec 4 (teams run evals, Redwood supports model pinning/variant routing)
- Acceptance gate: Dec 7 — mutual signoff on quality thresholds + usage compliance
- Takedown: Dec 10 — verified deletion + shared audit report

Constraints and commitments:
- Redwood accepts the prompt pack and test cases under an ephemeral access agreement: data is for pilot evaluation only, cannot be redistributed, and must be deleted within 72 hours of takedown verification.
- We'll provide access logs (S3 access events and request IDs) and a hashed manifest of files for verification.
- Attachments allowed: promptpack samples (zipped), MAP PDF, and the limited ingestion script we use. No persistent copies on our hosted side beyond the ephemeral staging.

Open items we want to confirm with you:
1) Exact file formats and schema for the 5k cases (CSV vs newline JSON) — your questionnaire helps but please confirm.
2) Do you require a non-disclosure amendment or will the MAP plus a short MPA suffice?
3) Any internal PII/data classifications we should pre-filter for?

Karthik will review the ops/SLA side and flag any capacity or routing requests. If that timeline looks good, we can lock the DocuSign envelope for the MAP on Wednesday.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_MAP_proposal_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP & dataset exchange — internal notes

Looping internally. Quick notes after skimming Sara's questionnaire and the MAP draft:
- File format: request CSV with header; Marissa suggests we accept newline-delimited JSON as an alternative but require schema doc.
- Data sanitization: we need confirmation that Mercury will remove direct PII. If not, we must enforce redaction pre-ingest.
- Quotas & routing: default to hosted for low-latency but we should offer a Dedicated variant if they want predictable throughput for large-batch evals (Karthik to advise).
- Access window enforcement: prefer time-limited signed URLs + IAM role with session expiration. We should capture audit records and provide a signed hash manifest.

Karthik — can you confirm GPU capacity and whether we can set a per-customer token budget for the pilot? Also, what quantization/variant options should we recommend for a retail summarization workload (int8 q4_kg maybe)?

Marissa
Head of Eval Programs, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:29:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP & dataset exchange — internal notes

Marissa, Olga — quick ops confirmation:
- Capacity: we can reserve a small Dedicated pool (2x A10G-equivalent) for the eval window; that'll keep latency stable for batch scoring. If they stay on hosted, we'll set autoscale with a hard throttle to avoid noisy neighbor issues.
- Token budget: recommend 10M tokens for the pilot (covers multiple model variants and reruns). We can enforce via per-route quotas in the Console.
- Model variants: for retail summarization, recommend starting with a float16 baseline + q8_0 quantized candidate for cost comparison; int8 options often introduce minor quality variance — include both in the MAP as A/B arms.
- Delivery: we'll provide an ingestion script that verifies manifests and uploads to Redwood staging; we can timebox the staging S3 to 14 days with lifecycle rules.

I'll add these as bullets in the MAP and prep a short ops checklist.

Karthik
Director, Serving & Capacity — Redwood Inference

From: Sara Park <sara.park@mercury-analytics.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, legal@mercury-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP & dataset exchange — next steps

Thanks — this looks good and aligns with our timeline. A couple quick confirmations before we route to Legal: 
- File format: we'll export CSV with header and include a schema doc; no PII in the sample set.
- Timeboxes: Nov 16 ingestion / Nov 23 start eval / Dec 7 acceptance gate / Dec 10 takedown — confirmed.
- Token budget: 10M is fine. We may request short spikes during tuning; happy to accept quota guards.

I've attached our completed data questionnaire and added Legal on Cc. They may ask for a short MPA addendum (we prefer that to a full contract amendment). We can also sign the DocuSign MAP link you shared once Legal finishes review.

Next steps: 1) Redwood to send final MAP with ops checklist and DocuSign link by EOD Wednesday; 2) Mercury to return signed MPA addendum within 48 hrs of Legal review; 3) ingestion week of Nov 16.

Sara Park
Product Partnerships — Mercury Analytics
